title: Senior Solutions Architect, Generative AI
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and implementing workflows based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
**The Role:**
Research is at the core of WorldQuant. Through rigorous exploration and unconstrained thinking about how to apply data to the financial markets, our researchers are in constant search of new alphas. Researchers at WorldQuant employ tested processes seeking to identify high-quality predictive signals that we believe are undiscovered by the wider market. These signals are mathematical expressions of data that are used as inputs in our quantitative models.
  
  
WorldQuant is seeking an exceptional individual to join the firm as a Quantitative Researcher. The person must have a strong understanding of the investment research process to create computer-based models that seek to predict movements of global financial markets. While prior finance experience is not required, a successful candidate must possess a strong interest in learning about finance and global markets. Candidates will have a research scientist mind-set; be a self-starter, a creative and persevering deep thinker who is motivated by unsolved challenges.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's (Hons), Master's or PhD degree in in a highly quantitative or highly analytical field e.g. Math, Physics, Computer Science or Financial Engineering from a leading university with excellent academic records are strongly preferred
* Have a research scientist mindset, i.e., be a deep thinker, creative, persevering, smart, a self-starter, etc.
* Knowledge of Linear Algebra, Statistics, Machine Learning
* Prior experience in Finance/Trading is a plus.
* Be competent in a programming language (Python, Unix)
* Possess good English language skills
* Have a strong interest in learning about worldwide financial markets
* Possess a relentless drive to succeed, supplemented by a strong work ethic

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.

* Innovation and Research:

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution

title: Research Engineer, Portfolio Management Group (PMG Tech), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Portfolio Management Group Technology (PMG Tech) is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group. The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with web-harvesting techniques and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence and machine learning tooling, large language model experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, and question-and-answer applications. Experience with dashboards, notebooks, lightweight research tools, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, or directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Team Member Credit Risk Modelling
description:
**Job Summary**
Team Member – Credit Risk Modelling will be responsible for the development, enhancement, implementation, and monitoring of Internal Rating Models and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 frameworks for wholesale portfolios. The role requires strong expertise in credit risk analytics, statistical modelling, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder management within a banking or NBFC environment.
  
  
The candidate should possess 7–8 years of relevant experience in credit risk modelling, with hands-on exposure to Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD), scorecards, internal rating frameworks, and ECL implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL Modelling & Implementation***
Support development and maintenance of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 framework.
  
  
Implement staging assessment methodologies, macroeconomic overlays, SICR frameworks, and forward-looking adjustments.
  
  
Monitor model performance and recommend enhancements based on portfolio behavior and economic trends.
  
  
Collaborate with finance, risk, and business teams for smooth implementation of ECL methodologies within the Bank/NBFC systems.
  
  
Support provisioning calculations, management reporting, and audit/regulatory requirements.
  
  
***Data Management & Analytics***
Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis using large datasets from multiple source systems.
  
  
Analyse portfolio trends, credit behaviour, migration patterns, and default characteristics.
  
  
Conduct statistical analysis and model diagnostics using SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Prepare dashboards and analytical reports for senior management and risk committees.
  
  
***Regulatory & Governance Support***
Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines, Basel framework, IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standards, and internal model governance policies.
  
  
Prepare model documentation, methodology papers, validation support documents, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Support internal audit, model risk management, and regulatory inspection requirements.
  
  
***Stakeholder Management***
Work closely with Risk, Finance, Business, IT, and Model Validation teams for implementation and monitoring activities.
  
  
Present model methodologies, assumptions, and performance outcomes to senior stakeholders and committees.
  
  
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of model-related initiatives.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
7–8 years of experience in Credit Risk Modelling within a Bank or NBFC.
  
  
Strong understanding of Internal Rating Models, Basel regulations, and IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL framework.
  
  
Hands-on experience in development/implementation of PD, LGD, EAD, scorecards, or rating models.
  
  
Good understanding of staging assessment, SICR, macroeconomic overlays, and provisioning methodologies.
  
  
Strong analytical and statistical modelling skills.
  
  
Proficiency in SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Experience in handling large datasets and performing quantitative analysis.
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to independently manage projects and interact with senior management.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
MBA / CA / FRM / CFA / Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or related quantitative discipline.
  
  
Experience in model validation or regulatory interaction will be an added advantage.
  
  
Exposure to wholesale and retail credit risk portfolios preferred. Role: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Credit Risk Modelling / IFRS 9 & Internal Rating Models

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic

* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

description:

On the testing side, the Assistant Vice President validates model changes through functional and end-to-end testing, ensuring accuracy and consistency across the results production process. Defect identification, resolution, and retesting are key responsibilities, along with maintaining a thorough audit trail for governance and approvals.

description:

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
****Process Overview****
The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
  
  
GIS Identity & Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
  
  
****Job Description****
The Data Engineering Services team is seeking a hands-on IAM Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering capabilities that strengthen Identity and Access Management controls, governance, and risk reduction across the enterprise.
  
  
This role will require to transform complex access, entitlement, identity lifecycle, privileged access, and control data into actionable insights. The candidate will design and develop scalable data pipelines, predictive and detective analytics, AI/ML models, dashboards, and self-service reporting capabilities that help identify control gaps, access anomalies, toxic combinations, certification inefficiencies, and emerging IAM risks. The role requires strong technical depth in analytics, model development, model governance, AI risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to convert data science outcomes into measurable control improvements and executive-ready risk narratives.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across IAM controls, access governance, entitlement management, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access certifications, and policy adherence.
* Analyze large, complex, and disparate identity, access, entitlement, control, application, and audit datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, risk concentrations, and opportunities for automation.
* Design, build, validate, and tune AI/ML models for IAM use cases such as access anomaly detection, entitlement mining, role mining, toxic access identification, certification prioritization, privileged access monitoring, and control effectiveness measurement.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, feature engineering processes, reusable datasets, and analytics frameworks using Python, R, SQL, Splunk, Neo4j, and enterprise-approved data platforms.
* Design and maintain executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions that convert IAM control data into actionable insights for process owners, risk partners, and senior leadership.
* Embed model governance and AI risk controls into the analytics lifecycle, including documentation, model inventory, validation evidence, explainability, performance monitoring, drift detection, data lineage, reproducibility, and audit traceability.
* Assess and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, privacy exposure, data quality limitations, explainability gaps, inappropriate automation, overfitting, and adversarial or unintended use of model outputs.
* Partner with IAM, GIS, cyber risk, audit, compliance, privacy, technology, and application teams to translate control requirements into measurable analytics solutions and governance outcomes.
* Drive process improvement and automation by identifying manual control activities, inefficient data handoffs, recurring exceptions, and opportunities to strengthen preventative and detective IAM controls.
* Prepare clear documentation, control evidence, methodology summaries, model performance updates, and risk narratives to support governance reviews, audit readiness, and management reporting.

****Requirements****
**Education :**
B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
  
  
**Certifications If Any**
: NA
  
  
**Experience Range : 10**
+ years
  
  
****Foundational Skills****

* Expertise in advanced data analytics and statistical modeling using Python, R, and SQL
* Proficiency in data visualization and graph analytics using Neo4j, Tableau, or equivalent tools
* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management architecture, technology and standards
* Strong quantitative analysis, data intuition, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
* Proficiency in AI, machine learning, data mining, feature engineering, and statistical analysis
* Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and executive presentation skills
* Proven experience in end-to-end model development lifecycle including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, deployment readiness, monitoring, drift detection, and performance tuning
* Strong knowledge of model governance practices including model documentation, model inventory, model cards, approval workflows, control evidence, audit traceability, and alignment with enterprise risk management expectations
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, explainability gaps, privacy exposure, data quality issues, model drift, overfitting, adversarial misuse, and inappropriate automation of access decisions
* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to IAM datasets such as entitlement mining, access anomaly detection, role mining, toxic access identification, privileged access monitoring, joiner-mover-leaver patterns, and access certification optimization

* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.

* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.

**Desirable Experience**

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Clinevo is building our go-to-market engine and looking for folks excited to get their hands dirty in a 0 to 1 journey. If you are expecting a ready-made GTM stack that you only need to maintain, Clinevo Technologies is probably not the right fit for you at this point. However, if you are excited about building the systems from scratch, we would love to hear from you.

We're seeking a hands-on GTM Engineer (B2B Saas) to build the automated systems that find, reach and convert pharmacovigilance buyers for Clinevo Technologies, from data and signals to AI-led outreach, routing and analytics.

You will partner with our sales, marketing, product and tech teams to design, build and run the workflows behind every stage of our funnel. You'll need to possess a strong drive, take ownership of your work, and have an insatiable desire to ship things and make them work.

This role requires a builder with hands-on experience in GTM automation, data enrichment and AI tools, adept at turning manual sales work into repeatable, measurable systems.

**Your responsibility won't be limited to but will include the following:**

* **Data Foundation:**
  Build and maintain a living database of pharma, biotech, CRO, med-device and veterinary companies, with waterfall enrichment for verified contacts and PV-specific data.
* **ICP and Scoring:**
  Define ICP tiers from won and lost deals, and build account and lead scores that blend fit, intent and engagement.
* **Signal Detection:**
  Track regulatory and business signals (FDA warning letters, EMA inspection findings, approvals, leadership changes, M&A, hiring) and route each one to the right play and owner.
* **Inbound Conversion:**
  Build an AI SDR that enriches, qualifies and replies to every website lead in under a minute, 24/7, with instant routing to the right regional rep.
* **Outbound at Scale:**
  Run signal-led, multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn and phone, with AI-assisted personalisation and human review.
* **Speed to Lead:**
  Alert reps on Slack or Teams the moment a target account engages, so they act while the prospect is warm.
* **Analytics and Reporting:**
  Build full-funnel dashboards, UTM tracking and attribution, and run experiments that improve conversion.

**Other role areas:**

* Sync target lists to LinkedIn matched-audience and retargeting ads, and build personalised landing pages per account or segment.
* Create personalised content at scale: AI-avatar demo videos, account one-pagers and ROI calculators.
* Pre-book meetings around PV conferences and webinars, and follow up within hours.
* Equip sales with pre-call briefs, AI call notes, RFP and security-questionnaire automation, and deal-risk alerts.
* Build expansion plays from customer health signals, champion tracking and cross-sell opportunities.
* Build AI agents and internal tools for research, qualification and CRM hygiene, with prompt libraries and quality checks.
* Own email infrastructure and deliverability, and keep outreach GDPR-compliant, with guardrails on AI-written copy.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  2–5 years in growth, GTM operations, RevOps or SDR roles, with at least one GTM automation shipped end to end in production.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Hands-on experience with Clay or similar enrichment tools, CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce), APIs, webhooks and JSON; scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building with AI coding tools such as Claude Code.
* **AI Skills:**
  Ability to write prompts that produce accurate, persona-specific copy, and judgement on where human review belongs.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Strong ability to measure funnels, attribution and experiments, and translate insights into action.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a system clearly in five minutes.
* **Collaboration:**
  Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with sales and marketing teams.
* **Adaptability:**
  Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, preferably within a SaaS startup.
* **Good to Have:**
  Exposure to life sciences or pharmacovigilance; German, French, Spanish or Italian.

**Location & timings:**

This is a full-time in-person role with the office based in Mumbai. Working pattern & hours are Monday - Friday, 40 hours per week. The timings typically would be 10.30am-7.30pm IST.

Summary:
  
  
The SAP Business AI Development Manager leads the design, engineering, and delivery of responsible, scalable AI solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). The role combines hands-on SAP architecture and development expertise with engineering leadership, delivery governance, and stakeholder management. The manager will embed AI and generative AI capabilities into enterprise processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Concur, supply chain, spend, and customer-experience solutions while maintaining clean-core, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.
  
  
SAP BTP Development Manager
  
  
SAP Business Technology Platform ,AI Engineering ,Generative AI ,Enterprise Application Development
  
  
Role: SAP BTP & Business AI Development Manager, Architect
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Solution strategy and architecture: Define solution approaches and reference architectures for embedded and side-by-side AI extensions on SAP BTP, balancing business value, scalability, security, maintainability, and clean-core principles.
  
  
Engineering leadership: Lead multidisciplinary teams of AI engineers, SAP BTP developers, data engineers, integration specialists, and quality engineers plan capacity, allocate work, remove delivery impediments, and coach team members.
  
  
AI Foundation delivery: Govern development using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and the generative AI hub, covering experimentation, model selection, deployment, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Generative AI adoption: Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, grounding, and rapid prototyping.
  
  
Business-process integration: Embed capabilities such as intelligent document processing, natural-language interfaces, workflow automation, recommendations, forecasting, and decision support into SAP and non-SAP processes.
  
  
Application development: Oversee SAP CAP, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and Kyma-based development, including APIs, events, integrations, and reusable services.
  
  
AI-assisted engineering: Guide responsible use of Joule for Developers and SAP Build Code for code scaffolding, explanation, refactoring, test generation, and review support.
  
  
Quality and DevSecOps: Ensure AI-generated and developer-created artifacts are reviewed, validated, tested, secured, traceable, and approved before release drive CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and production-support practices.
  
  
Responsible AI and governance: Implement controls for privacy, security, transparency, content safety, bias mitigation, human oversight, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.
  
  
Capability building: Create engineering standards, reusable accelerators, reference implementations, and learning plans that strengthen AI, application development, integration, analytics, and data-engineering capabilities.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP and relevant services, including SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, the generative AI hub, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Build Code, and SAP Integration Suite.
  
  
Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI observability.
  
  
Proficiency in one or more SAP development stacks: SAP CAP with Node.js or Java, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, REST APIs, and event-driven integration.
  
  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and microservices on Cloud Foundry and,or Kyma,Kubernetes, supported by Git, CI,CD, automated testing, and secure DevOps practices.
  
  
Good understanding of SAP BTP security, including identity and access management, OAuth, role-based access, secrets management, data protection, and secure API design.
  
  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled business processes in SAP S/4HANA and one or more SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Sales Cloud, or Signavio.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to convert business opportunities into solution designs, delivery plans, estimates, risks, controls, and measurable outcomes.

Master's degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematics, or a related field.

This is an opportunity to own a new product domain, experiment with emerging technologies, and take products from zero to one - with real-world deployment across a large retail network.

1. Own the product roadmap: Identify high-impact opportunities for AI and technology across the in-store customer journey, translate them into product requirements, and drive execution from discovery to deployment.

5. Drive end-to-end execution: Work closely with engineering, design, data, and external technology partners to prototype, test, launch and iterate on products.
6. Experiment and validate: Develop MVPs, run controlled pilots in stores, analyze product usage and performance, and use learnings to refine solutions before scaling.
7. Build for scale and reliability: Ensure products work seamlessly across store environments, hardware configurations and connectivity conditions, with a focus on performance, usability, reliability and maintainability.
8. Leverage data and automation: Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, integrate retail systems and use customer interaction data to continuously improve product performance.
9. Measure product outcomes: Define KPIs, track adoption and engagement, diagnose product friction, and use quantitative and qualitative insights to priorities improvements.

1. Preferable (not mandatory) experience in product management : in AI/ML products, consumer tech, computer vision, IoT or other technology-led products.

title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI systems. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge will directly shape how AI reasons about hardware, architecture, and systems.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to apply your expertise in a meaningful, flexible way — working remotely on cutting-edge AI problems at the frontier of computer engineering.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Challenges — Craft advanced computer engineering problems spanning RISC-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware-software co-design to stress-test AI reasoning
* Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions — including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams — that serve as reference benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated code (C/C++, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernels for technical accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards
* Refine AI Reasoning — Identify logical flaws such as race conditions, memory leaks, and timing constraint violations, and deliver structured feedback that improves how AI models think through problems

**Who You Are**

* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related discipline
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low-level software logic clearly in writing
* Precise and detail-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and timing diagrams
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or AI benchmarking
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, SolidWorks, or ANSYS
* Familiarity with embedded systems toolchains or HDL simulation environments

**Why Join Us**

* Work on intellectually stimulating problems at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Collaborate with a global network of domain experts and leading AI researchers
* Freelance autonomy with the potential for ongoing contract extension
* Make a direct, lasting impact on how AI understands the physical and logical world of computing

title: Senior Director - Cloud & AI Platform Engineering
description:
**What are we looking for**

*real solver?*

**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.**
We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.

**Your Mission: The Role**

solving for better.

You own delivery for Cloud & AI Platform Engineering: cloud foundations and migration, data platforms, AI and MLOps foundations, private AI, and the agent runtime that sits on top of them. Every CAPE engagement you lead ends with something running in production, with a named owner, at a cost the client can defend.

Most firms split this work into a cloud team, a data team, an AI team and a FinOps function on the side. Agents ignore those boundaries, so the failures land in the gaps between them. You run CAPE as one system, and you hold it to one bar: evidence from production, not a plan someone approved.

If you have led platform delivery at enterprise scale, you are fluent in how agents actually fail, and you treat utilisation and inference cost as seriously as architecture, this is your seat.

**Your Responsibilities**

*what you will wake up to solve.*

**‣Make the estate agent-ready**

* **Own platform delivery end to end:**
  Lead every CAPE engagement across landing zones, migration, data platforms, MLOps and private or sovereign AI, with running production systems as the finish line rather than approved plans.
* **Build the agent runtime properly:**
  Deliver durable execution, multi-agent orchestration, tool interoperability and agent observability, so client agents survive mid-run failures, act safely across systems, and can be operated by whoever inherits them.
* **Engineer what models can see:**
  Treat retrieval, context engineering and decision instrumentation as first-class deliverables, judged by the business decisions they improve.

**‣Run delivery on evidence, not optimism**

* **Own the delivery economics:**
  Be accountable for billable utilisation, effort efficiency and deviation from SOW across the CAPE portfolio, and make sure we have the people before we promise the work.
* **Deliver cost as an outcome:**
  Make cloud and AI economics part of the engagement: cost allocation, commitment restructuring and lower cost per AI task without a drop in quality, proven by measurement.
* **Report performance honestly:**
  Keep partner-funded work visible separately, so margin and utilisation reflect what the business unit actually earns.

**‣Nothing ships unowned**

* **Launch with an owner:**
  Every platform goes live with someone accountable for running it and the telemetry they need from day one.
* **Escalate early:**
  Surface risks to the client-facing lead before the client has to raise them.
* **Plan the next step at launch:**
  Every go-live comes with a view of what to improve next, so delivery becomes a relationship, not a closing date.

**‣Build the bench by route, not by default**

* **Hold the credential bar:**
  Set and enforce the certification and hands-on standard for cloud, data, ML and FinOps crafts, requalified on real delivery evidence, with leaders held to the same bar as engineers.
* **Choose build or buy per capability:**
  Grow existing strengths through training, and hire where the market is moving faster than training can, such as agent platform engineering.
* **Turn delivery into differentiation:**
  Maintain working accelerators for landing zones, agent platforms and retrieval, publish on what the team has learned, and represent Searce with our cloud and AI partners.

**Welcome to Searce**

*The ‘process-first’, AI-native modern tech consultancy that's rewriting the rules.*

**We don’t do traditional.**

As an engineering-led consultancy, we are dedicated to relentlessly improving the real business outcomes. Our solvers co-innovate with clients to
**futurify**
operations and make processes smarter, faster & better. We build alongside our clients. Not for the vanity metrics. But for the transformation to embed lasting competitive advantage for our clients.

The result? Modern business reinvention, built on math, tech, and clarity of purpose.

**Functional Skills**

* **Portfolio Judgment:**
  Reads a portfolio of concurrent engagements and knows which one breaks next, and why, before the dashboard turns red.
* **Delivery Economics:**
  Translates technical scope into effort, capacity, cost and margin, and knows which trade-off protects all of them.
* **Capability Strategy:**
  Decides, craft by craft, what to train, what to hire and what to stop offering, based on evidence rather than hope.
* **Standards that Hold:**
  Sets a quality bar people can be measured against, and holds it with leaders as firmly as with new joiners.
* **Executive Candour:**
  Delivers bad news early, with options, to client and internal leadership alike.

**Tech Superpowers**

* **Cloud Foundations and Migration:**
  Hands-on background in landing zones, networking, identity, infrastructure as code (Terraform), containerisation and large-scale migration on Google Cloud and AWS, at Professional Cloud Architect or Solutions Architect Professional depth.
* **Data Platform Engineering:**
  Lakehouse, streaming, data quality and lineage on platforms such as BigQuery, Databricks and Kafka.
* **AI and Agent Runtime:**

  FinOps practice (allocation, showback, anomaly detection), committed-use and reserved-capacity instruments, and inference cost levers such as model routing, caching and batching.

  Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent.
* **Track Record:**
  Has taken enterprise platforms that run AI or agent workloads into production for multiple clients.
* **Still Builds:**
  Has personally shipped something with a large language model in the recent past, not only overseen a team that did.
* **Team Scale:**
  Has led a delivery organisation of engineers and architects across more than one craft.

**Join the ‘real solvers’**

ready to futurify?

If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses, apply here and experience the ‘
*Art of the possible*
’.

title: EHS&S Digital Solution Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
Dow has an exciting and challenging opportunity for
**Digital Solution Specialist**
, based in
**Navi Mumbai (India)**
to join the
**Environment, Health, Safety and Sustainability (EHS&S)**
Information Technology team. In this role, you will own and manage a small EHS&S portfolio of digital solutions and systems, guiding them through their full lifecycle—analysis, design, implementation, adoption, optimization, and end-of-life retirement. Your work will deliver advanced EHS&S functional and business capabilities that accelerate Dow’s digital transformation.
  
  
You will collaborate with a multi-disciplinary IT team—including analysts, designers, developers, and support specialists—to deliver innovative, user-centric solutions. A key part of your role is to gather and analyze data to define functional and technical requirements, with a strong focus on experience, simplification, automation, efficiency, and reliability. You will also oversee development and adoption of solutions leveraging best-in-class mobile, web, desktop, and cloud technologies, while identifying opportunities for digital innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Requirements Analysis: Understand key business drivers to explore, analyze, and map business and functional requirements.
* Experience Mapping: Translate user journeys and stories into solutions that enhance employee and customer experience (EX/CX).
* Solution Lifecycle Management: Drive end-to-end lifecycle—design, architecture, integration (buy vs. build), development, testing, and compliance with corporate standards and security policies.
* Adoption & Support: Support implementation, user adoption, and define supplier/team support models.
* Performance Management: Establish controls, KPIs, and measures for solution performance and reliability.
* Integration & Optimization: Coordinate with Solution Managers and Business Process Managers for end-to-end process integration.
* Roadmap Development: Define improvement and innovation roadmaps; assess resources, technology, and investment needs.
* Team Support: Assist senior Solution Managers with workload analysis and capacity planning.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems using technical expertise and sound judgment. Strong communication skills to explain complex concepts and provide informal guidance to new team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, EHS&S, or a related field.
* Min 5+ years of work experience in the role.
* Knowledge and experience with EHS and Sustainability processes and technologies.
* Experience supporting sustainability, decarbonization, carbon accounting, environmental compliance, product carbon footprint (PCF), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) initiatives through digital solutions and data-driven capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation technologies.
* Strong understanding of system integration and application architecture, including API integrations, data flow analysis, end-to-end process integration, and Azure Integration Services.
* Experience working with Databricks, SQL, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) and Copilot solutions.
* Knowledge of software development concepts and modern application delivery practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Understanding of cloud-based technologies, enterprise data management, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Your Skills**

* Business Requirements: The ability to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements that guide the design and delivery of effective digital solutions.
* Solutions Delivery: Managing the full lifecycle of digital solutions—including design, integration, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and retirement—to ensure they meet performance, security, and usability expectations.
* Design Thinking: Applying user‑centered methods such as journey mapping and experience analysis to create solutions that improve employee and customer experience while driving simplification, automation, and efficiency.
* Integration Services: Coordinating and defining end‑to‑end system and process integrations to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across applications, platforms, and business processes.
* Strategic Planning: Developing solution roadmaps, identifying digital innovation opportunities, and aligning technology investments and resource needs with organizational strategy and long‑term business goals environment.

**Additional Notes**

* The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential.
* Relocation assistance is not provided with this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Director, Portfolio Solution Engineering
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
NICE, the market leader in cloud-based contact center technology, is looking for an experienced Solution Consultant to excite potential customers about its extensive portfolio and aid them in ultimately becoming a NICE customer. A successful Solution Consultant will work consultatively with prospects to identify their goals and business drivers, and creatively design a solution that will meet the ever-growing demands of their contact center needs. * Own Presales end-to-end: pipeline, solution strategy, POC governance, and win/loss review
* Lead on complex enterprise AI deals from first discovery through technical sign-off
* Design and oversee POCs — including data requirements, model evaluation, integration architecture, and results framing
* Coach Solutions Consultants on AI solutioning, technical storytelling, and commercial positioning
* Build repeatable playbooks, demo frameworks, and discovery guides specific to AI/ML products
* Feed structured field intelligence back into Product and GTM strategy
* Represent the company at industry events and in customer advisory conversations.

* 12–16 years in Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Sales Engineering — 3+ years leading a team
* Last 2+ years hands-on in AI product Pre-Sales — not adjacent to it, in it
* Working knowledge of the AI stack: LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, inference costs, token economics, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and API-based AI services
* Able to scope and run technically rigorous POCs without needing an engineer to translate
* Commercial fluency around AI pricing models — tokens, compute, licensing, and total cost of ownership conversations with procurement and finance
* Deep experience with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
* A coach who leads by doing — you get in the deal, run the discovery, fix the demo, then debrief the team on why
